changelog: Fix: Chart page layout — removed the dead space above/below the chart and made it fill from directly under the controls bar to the bottom of the viewport (flex-based, no hardcoded pixel height), with no page-level scrollbar while the chart is open. Scoped entirely to a new body.chart-active class (set in js/app.js::showPage()) — every other page's layout is unchanged.

Change: the chart's controls bar is now a compact, dark bar (roughly half its old height) matching the chart's own theme instead of the light card style used elsewhere in the app — inline controls, no vertical label stacking, the "Data from ..." note right-aligned and muted.
Change: the page header (title + Trade/PDF buttons) switches to the chart's dark theme only while the chart page is open — every other page keeps its current light header.

Add: collapsible sidebar, app-wide — a toggle collapses it to an icon-only rail (WordPress-admin style), with each item's label shown as a hover tooltip while collapsed. Persisted in localStorage and restored before first paint (no flash-of-uncollapsed-sidebar on load). Disabled below 900px, where the sidebar is already a mobile overlay drawer, not a rail.

Fix: the chart now explicitly calls resize() (not just Lightweight Charts' own autoSize) on the sidebar's own transitionend (width) and on window resize, so collapsing/expanding the sidebar or resizing the window doesn't leave the canvas stretched or squashed.
release_notes: UI/layout only — no database changes, no migration involved. Nothing here touches migrations/2026_09_24_0002_create_backtesting_tables.sql, still pending from v3.19.0 (run migrate.php?mode=run after Update Now if you haven't already).
